Intro: So, it is done. The royal family is no more.
I truly wish the outcome was different, but this mess, this War. Their hands are soaked in the blood of my people, as they had to yours.
I don't know how many Moġarans remain, hell, I may even be the last. But I am glad someone remembers the meals of the Fields, should the worst happen.
Thank you, friend. How about a [DISH]? So we celebrate a new dawn. May fair Moġara rise from the yoke of Old Aijinkova.
Success: Yes! Incredible work, young cook! Until next time.
Fail: Ah. I understand the stress of the situation. I will return once the fire dies down.
Reject: Oh… fuck, this is really happening. Please God, tell me if more are still out there, please…
